items.title: What You will learn
items.text: In this course, you will learn to develop applications with Django, a web-framework written in Python.

items.title: Why Django?
items.text:
• It is so easy and fast : You can ship an idea without relying on any extra functionality.

  • It is Fully loaded : You can handle almost all common web development tasks including authentication, content management etc.

  • It is Secure : Django provides many security features in addition to its strong authentication framework.

  • It is versatile : It has been used to build all sorts of applications with all sorts of scale.

items.title: Who needs this course?
items.text:
Anyone getting started with Django.

You will require to have knowledge about some of these topics. It is not a must.

= Python: You can write simple programs in Python. - Core web Technologies:: You can build simple websites using HTML, CSS And JavaScript.

But do not worry if you have never done so, I got you!

items.title: Installing Django
items.text: To get started, you will need to have Python installed. Visit the official Python website and download an installer for your operating system.

items.title: Verify Your Installation
items.text:
After a successful installation, you will have the python3 command in your commandline interface.

Note

We are going to be using the commandline a lot, please do not fret, I will hold your hand and explain everything.
